definitions.explanation: the sheltered area beneath the overhanging roof edge of a building

examples.japanese: {軒下|のきした}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{雨宿|あまやど}り→雨宿り：14929_amayadori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Take shelter from the rain under the eaves.

examples.japanese: ツバメ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{軒下|のきした}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巣|す}→巣：02140_su⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Swallows built a nest under the eaves.

examples.japanese: {軒下|のきした}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}めてある→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。
examples.english: The bicycle is parked under the eaves.

notes:
{軒下|のきした} refers to the sheltered space beneath a roof's overhang.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{軒|のき}→軒：03912_noki⟧: Eaves (the edge of a roof that overhangs)
- ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧: Under, beneath

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- Shelter from rain or sun
- Space for hanging laundry, storing items
- Nesting location for birds (especially swallows)
- {軒下|のきした}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{雨宿|あまやど}り→雨宿り：14929_amayadori⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (take shelter from rain under the eaves)
- {軒下|のきした}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧ (to hang/dry under the eaves)
- {軒下|のきした}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巣|す}→巣：02140_su⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to build a nest under the eaves)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Swallows (⟦{燕|つばめ}→燕：04362_tsubame⟧) building nests under {軒下|のきした} is traditionally considered good luck in Japan. Homeowners often welcome these nests.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{軒|のき}→軒：03912_noki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貸|か}して→貸す：00537_kasu⟧{母屋|おもや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}られる→取る：00565_toru⟧: "Lend the eaves and lose the main house" - a proverb meaning giving someone an inch and they take a mile.

REGISTER: Neutral.
